title: Gagliardo–Nirenberg–Sobolev inequality for C¹ compactly supported functions on ℝ^(n+1), n ≥ 1, with the L¹ norm of the derivative as a Bochner integral
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, N := n + 1, and p := (n + 1)/n computed in ℝ≥0∞. There is a real c > 0 such that every C¹ function v : ℝ^N → ℝ with compact support satisfies eLpNorm(v, p, L^N) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(c ∫ ‖Dv(y)‖ dL^N(y)), where Dv(y) = fderiv ℝ v y, ‖·‖ is the operator norm and L^N = volume on ℝ^N = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ v : Rn (n + 1) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 v → HasCompactSupport v → eLpNorm v ((n + 1 : ℝ≥0∞) / n) volume ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * ∫ y, ‖fderiv ℝ v y‖)
